original.statement: Loki 3.0.0 changes metrics namespace prefix from `cortex_` to `loki_`; the `metrics_namespace` config key can be set to `cortex` to retain the old prefix, but this setting is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release.

corrected.statement: In Loki 3.0.0, metrics that started with `cortex_` now start with `loki_`, because they follow `metrics_namespace` (default `loki`). Setting `metrics_namespace` to `cortex` keeps the old prefix. The setting is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release.

decision.reason: [ev-1f419676f177] says some metrics that used the `cortex_` prefix now start with `loki_`, and that `metrics_namespace` defaults to `loki` (set it to `cortex` to keep the old names). The subject config-key `metrics_namespace` is right. The change is wrong: `cortex_*` and `loki_*` are metric-name prefixes, not values of the key. The evidence also never says the key's previous default was `cortex`, so neither value-changed nor default-changed is supported. The supported reading is behavior-changed: with the key at its default `loki`, the listed metrics are now emitted with the `loki_` prefix.
